name: The Hero's Brand
label: Quest
description: The Hero's Brand: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The King has acknowledged your existence, adventurer. You are the first of your kind to be accepted by Rastakhan as a true ally of Zandalar.
You will be rewarded greatly for your efforts. Present your brand and I shall apply the final amplification.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Vigilance, honor, loyalty, bravery... You embody all of these traits and so shall your brand.
